info.name: AFTER/FORM — Step 9: Artist Access and Error Checks
info.description: Local integration checks with two fresh QA artists, synthetic WAV and invalid fixtures. Use scripts/Test-ArtistSecurity.ps1 for automatic setup/execution. Each folder needs a fresh test-server process: rate counters are per process. For manual Postman runs, use separate QA accounts and restart the test server before EVERY folder; do not run all folders consecutively against your everyday server. Passwords are intentionally blank. File and hash variables are prepared by the local runner. No environment/cookie/credential export.
